answer: Natural bond decay stops bulk forgery. Each agent posts a 50 POA bond losing a delta of 5 POA each idle epoch, so only working agents keep a full bond, like a terrace. An honest agent pays once and renews from earnings, keeping undiluted rewards. Forging 100 identities costs 5,000 POA and bleeds 500 POA per idle epoch, while fakes earn nothing before fading. Old ivory bonds cannot be rented or transferred, so buyers get only decayed value.
